title: Spectral Thickness of Fibonacci Hamiltonians
known_component: Published positive-constant upper and lower bounds of order 1/lambda as lambda tends to zero.
strongest_verified_result: Known weak-coupling order law, plus elementary non-spectral obstruction lemmas and a conditional finite-gap monotonicity lemma.
remaining_mathematical_gap: A valid coupling comparison uniform over every true spectral gap generation, or a certified spectral pair contradicting monotonicity. The conditional finite-gap lemma does not verify its spectral endpoint/hull hypotheses or a common coupling interval. Exact true-gap exhaustion has a generic limit identity, but the numerical periodic covers have not been identified with such fillers.
independent_review: Original audit accepts unsolved 5/5 subject to corrections; corrected-release binding review pending.
corrections_applied: Require a nonempty finite gap collection.
Require every hull and gap endpoint function to extend C1 through zero.
Require a gap bijection inducing a bijection of all presentations.
Prove the generic exact true-gap exhaustion identity without a spectral-cover identification or coupling-uniformity claim.
Distinguish exact rational controls from floating-point calibrations and diagnostics.
